method: Monthly S&P composite (Shiller, nominal) for swings; trough = lowest close in [election-4M, election+6M]; fear = high since Jan of election year to trough; relief = trough to high in next 12M; moves under 0.5% are dashes, not swings; macro monthly from FRED; hit = trough within 2 months of election month; weekly check (1970+, Yahoo weekly bars): trough in [vote-12w, vote+26w], relief to +52w, hits at ±4w/±8w.
